name: qfd_hub_ps-f6e3d8cad-tt
purpose: TT-BATCH (owner option B, one large batch): qfd_hub_ps-f6e3d8cad re-routed at ORFS CORNER=TC (setup repair at TT), flow-hold mm FF hold HM 50, rule H1, CTS fix hooks + consistent die-link budget; original source commit kept; verdict TT setup >= 0 / FF hold >= 0 / DRC 0, SS = sensitivity. | was: Qwen qfd_hub PS=1: ar_d/link-output pin stations (+1 cycle each way), fck-domain pin register of the returned credit count (port->sync path); was SS -68.0 (ard_q->ar_d, lo_q->l1_o, l2_i->t1)

bench.name: hub_exact
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/hb0 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.PS=1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.NEG=0 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/hb0 | tee {RUN}/bench/hb0.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/hb0.log

bench.name: hub_neg
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/bench && iverilog -g2012 -o {RUN}/bench/hb1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.PS=1 -P tb_qwen_die_hub.NEG=1 rtl/test/tb_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_hub.sv rtl/physical/ot_qwen_die_cdc_ch.sv rtl/lib/ot_async_fifo.sv rtl/lib/ot_reset_sync.sv && vvp -n {RUN}/bench/hb1 | tee {RUN}/bench/hb1.log && grep -q '^PASS' {RUN}/bench/hb1.log

route.cmd: TTB=$(ls -d /srv/opentallas-scratch/claude/ttbatch/26f14af32 /home/ubuntu/closure-loop-local/ttbatch/26f14af32 2>/dev/null | head -1) && export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 $TTB/tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; SRC={SRC} bash physical/qwen_die_masters/jobs/route_master.sh qfd_hub_ps {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/hbm_fmax_attn_abstract.py --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --name qfd_hub --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_hub --image openroad/orfs:asap7lock  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
